Name: Hiram, Craftsman of Tyre
Summary: Hiram, a widow's son of Tyre skilled in bronze, cast the two pillars, the sea, the bases, and all the vessels for Solomon's temple, and finished all the work for the house of the LORD.
KeyStory: Hiram casts the temple's bronze works.
RelatedPeople: King Solomon; Hiram, King of Tyre
LifeLesson: God-given skill, offered to God's house, becomes part of worship itself.
